official_response_independent_metadata.source: GBIF IPT Study Extent for version 1.0
official_response_independent_metadata.reason: Study Extent explicitly defines the foundational core dataset and is internally consistent with the Event-core 30-coordinate-site intersection; Project Data contains the known 30-versus-31 inconsistency

site_identity.rule: island code plus decimalLatitude and decimalLongitude rounded to 5 decimal places
site_identity.why_not_locationID: locationID yields only 29 three-phase intersections whereas the coordinate key yields exactly 30 across seven islands with zero coordinate inconsistency
site_identity.final_core_site_set: the intersection of site keys occurring in Event-core rows within all three frozen phase windows

core_event_rule.retain: Event-core row whose site key belongs to the frozen 30-site intersection and whose year lies inside its phase window
